text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The world's summit— As long as one does 
not give up on that dream, the path 
continues. Keep walking, and the future 
will pave the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe behind 
them, the project members run again today, 
looking toward the next grand opening.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Never giving up, keeping the flame of 
romance alive, charging toward the dream 
of becoming the best in the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dreams only come true for those who 
continue to hold the burning wish to win.
